configs.hypothesis: Dense baseline with starter context budget.
Exact protocol names may favor lexical matching.
RRF can combine semantic and exact-term rankings.
Larger context may retain complete retrieved evidence; only budget changes from dense baseline.
More candidates and a larger context may improve coverage. Two factors change together; not a causal isolation.

selection_rule: AI-assisted reviewed answer-grade mean, then correct abstention count, supported citation rate, prepared final-context evidence rate, then lower estimated cost, then name. Student validation remains necessary.
